$description: Voom brand tokens. Source: Voom Brand Guidelines 2026 (colors, type, grid, logo) + derived motion tokens (marked proposed).

blue.role: Primary brand blue. Mid stop of the signature gradient, solid brand fills.

lightBlue.role: Accent / highlight words / glow / partnership diamond / light end of gradient.

deepBlue.role: Darkest brand tone. Dark end of gradient, dark backgrounds, text on light.

offWhite.role: Text on blue, light backgrounds, logo on dark. Never pure white for the logo.

gradient.note: Cover/divider slides run deep blue (bottom-left) to light blue (top-right). Product sheets use a deep-blue field with a blue/light-blue glow.

status._note: Product UI status colors seen in CRM sync screens. Use only when depicting product states, never as brand colors.

type._note: Sizes are the book's reference at 1920x1080. Scale proportionally for other canvases. Tracking is in 1/1000 em.

grid.textMargin: centre of the first grid square (half a cell from the edge)

logo.safeZone: X = 1/4 of the logo height, on all four sides
colorways: pure black or white on any off-palette surface
logo.smallSizes: 75% / 50% / 25% scale references drop the tagline and use the wordmark only

motion._status: PROPOSED. The brand book has no motion chapter. These are derived from the rocket symbol and the gradient glow language. Confirm with the brand owner before treating as official.
